title: Coffer Solana M-08 rounding — fix deployed 2026-10-19; per-call bound one raw unit (<= $0.0008/leg)
closed_reasons: Post-incident fix deployed at slot 458,810,142 (2026-10-19T11:04:29Z), after the 2026-10-18 incident and before the prior behavioural simulation at slot 464,630,474
ProgramData is still at that deploy slot and its SHA-256 is unchanged; no rollback or redeploy
Prior simulateTransaction showed actual_balance credited in full and virtual_balance increased by the auditors' exact div_up/mul_up fix
Even unpatched, M-08 is bounded to one raw unit per live leg per call; all 29 pool mints have 5-9 decimals, so one raw unit is at most $0.0007726891 (1 sat of an 8-dp BTC token)
key_facts: 43 pools total: 27 v5 (1683 bytes, all pool_enabled) + 16 legacy (1154 bytes)
29 unique pool mints, decimals 5-9; max one raw unit $0.0007726891; max 9-leg call $0.0069542
2026-10-18 incident realised ~$0.7 from thousands of deposits
caveats: Program source is private; fix verified behaviourally and by deployment identity, not by source diff
No fresh simulation was run in this pass because the ProgramData has not changed since the prior simulation's slot; a future upgrade requires re-testing
TVL is DefiLlama's figure and is not attacker-extractable via this bug
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live: the M-08 rounding fix is still the deployed bytecode (last deploy 2026-10-19, unchanged since), and the unpatched per-call ceiling is one raw unit per leg <= $0.0008.
